decisions.reason: The dashboard shell and canvas are a separate design target from the common treatment requested for follow-on website pages.
Adding the dashboard shell and canvas as console design targets does not change the separately stated responsive behavior for website layouts.
The source lists landing-page finalization and dashboard shell styling as separate work areas and does not apply the console targets to the landing-page visual design.
The console design-target change does not modify the landing-page font or button-color preferences.
The dashboard shell and canvas styling request does not change the website implementation stack or handoff objective.
